description.value:
Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1

Ammo Types Available: Grenades

Designed for riot control in Tokyo, these Arasaka-made throwable devices blast intense infrasonic vibrations in all directions, causing burst eardrums, brain bleeds, and rapid dispersal of unauthorized public gatherings.

Grenade Ammunition that deals no damage. Anyone hit by it must attempt to beat a DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs Check. Anyone who fails suffers the effects of the Concussion and Lost Ear Critical Injuries, but does not suffer their Death Save Penalty increase or Bonus Damage.

Stack: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
